title: Start independent orientation prompts without auto-resumed task history
hypothesis: A fresh session produces a more accurate, concise project orientation with lower context cost than automatically resuming unrelated prior task history.
falsified_if: Fresh context reduces deterministic pass rate or mean score, or fails to remove stale verification claims without a material prompt-token reduction.
decision_rule: Prefer fresh startup for independent CLI invocations if it is non-inferior on pass rate and score, eliminates stale-history claims, and reduces mean prompt tokens by at least 20%. Keep explicit resume available for intentional continuation.
